documentProblem: DESIGN.md L2 ("Frontend discovery is advisory; transaction decisions must reread current chain state.") spans both on-chain execution enforcement and off-chain client/frontend pre-submission behavior; packages/contracts contains only Solidity contracts, so off-chain client pre-submission state rereads cannot be verified from contract code alone.

evidence.role: Reads live block.timestamp during createRaffle to validate endTime and saleDuration on-chain.
Rereads live external ERC-721 ownerOf and clone status() after safeTransferFrom during raffle creation.
Reads live status, block.timestamp, and totalEntries in buyEntries before assigning contiguous entry ranges from live storage.
Reads live status, block.timestamp, totalEntries, and live Chainlink VRF wrapper fee (both via getVrfRequestPrice and requestRandomnessPayInNative) in requestDraw.
Reads live ticket ownerOf(ticketId) at redemption time before burning, and rereads prizeToken.ownerOf after transferring the NFT prize.
Rereads live ownerOf(ticketId) and ticketRange(ticketId) and burns each ticket per iteration in refundTickets.
Verifies off-chain/frontend-discovered candidate ticketId against live stored _ticketRanges[ticketId] and winningEntry during settlement.
Rereads live code.length and canonicalFactory.isRaffle(destination) on every ticket transfer and quote-token payout.

reasoning: Every on-chain state-changing function in RaffleFactory and Raffle reads and enforces live chain state during execution (status, block.timestamp, totalEntries, ticketCount, _ticketRanges, winningEntry, ownerOf(ticketId), live VRF wrapper pricing via calculateRequestPriceNative, live factory isRaffle registry, and post-transfer prizeToken.ownerOf) and exposes complete view getters for callers to reread current chain state, so the verdict is implemented rather than partial; off-chain client pre-submission behavior is outside packages/contracts.

searched.result: Found requirement at L2: "Frontend discovery is advisory; transaction decisions must reread current chain state."

All 11 state-changing functions, internal hooks (_update, fulfillRandomWords), and helpers (_settleWinningTicket, _transferQuote, _requireStatus, _requireWinningTicket, _isProtocolDestination) read live storage and external chain state during execution.
constructor and createRaffle read live code.length, decimals(), supportsInterface, block.timestamp, isRaffle, and reread prize.ownerOf and IRaffle(raffle).status() after safeTransferFrom.
Confirmed full external view getter surface and NatSpec notes on live state changes (e.g., IRaffle.sol:L360).
Confirmed requestRandomnessPayInNative queries live i_vrfV2PlusWrapper.calculateRequestPriceNative (L82) and ERC721.ownerOf/_burn read and update live _owners[tokenId] storage.
